title: Narc Pattern
intro: Everyone has some Narc pattern: the pull to protect yourself by contracting. Holding your position, going quiet, deflecting blame. This check shows how strongly that pull runs in you right now, across the four Narc codes. Answer about how you actually behave, especially in conflict.

items.text: I can say what I want without needing to control the outcome.
When I feel challenged, my first move is to protect my position.
I'm comfortable letting someone else lead, even when I'd do it differently.
I like things done my way, and I get tense when they aren't.
I can stay in a hard conversation even when it gets emotional.
When someone is upset with me, I go silent or switch off.
When I need space, I say so rather than just going quiet.
I switch to logic or facts when someone wants me to hear how they feel.
I can say "I got that wrong" without adding a "but".
I find a way to show it wasn't really my fault.
I apologise for my part even when the other person was wrong too.
I remember other people's mistakes more clearly than my own.
I notice how I'm coming across while it's happening.
People tell me I was harsh or cold, and I genuinely didn't notice.
I can tell when someone feels dismissed by me, even if they don't say it.
I think people are too sensitive about the way I say things.
I don't need to win an argument to feel okay about myself.
I know I pull back or harden when things get intense.
Under pressure, protecting myself matters more than how the other person feels.
When I feel cornered, I say things I later regret.

narc.title: The Narc pull is strong
narc.text: Under pressure you contract hard. Holding your position, going quiet or deflecting keeps you safe in the moment, but it costs closeness, and people may stop bringing things to you. The codes in red below are where it costs you most.

empath.title: The Narc pull is light
empath.text: You don't tend to protect yourself by contracting. If anything you lean the other way. Take the Empath side seriously too: the full Awareness Profile maps both.

loop.title: The Narc pull switches on and off
loop.text: Some of the time you contract hard, some of the time you don't. That on-off pattern is often what confuses the people close to you most. The red codes show where it fires.

mixed.title: Some Narc pull, not running the show
mixed.text: There's a Narc pull in you, like everyone, but it isn't running the show. The codes below show where it's strongest, and where a small change would make the biggest difference.

zero.title: Close to Zero-Point
zero.text: You can stay present, own your part and notice your impact more often than not. Keep practising, especially on the codes still showing amber.

cta.text: This check looks at one side of the loop. The full Awareness Profile maps both roles and all 16 codes, with a Level out of 10.
